items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: I just played with them, they just got the brass band, I played with the brass band.

ctx.x: The only ones, two bands I played with, Ray Zan, Stutter, my brother and Chris Kelley. Gibson band?
Hmm? Don't you work with the Gibson band, Stutter?
No, I don't have been playing with them, I only forgot to hold on. See, I just played with them, they just got the brass band, I played with the brass band.
